references.text: Elteke and Gibbethon are mentioned as cities in the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, which were later given to the Levites.
Gibbethon is mentioned in connection with Nadab, king of Israel, who was killed while besieging this Philistine city.
Gibbethon is mentioned again when Omri was proclaimed king while Israel was besieging the city.
The context for the allocation of Levitical cities to the sons of Kohath from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan.
Parallel text in 1 Chronicles describing the Levitical cities given to the descendants of Aaron.
